subject: AI & Agents
title: Small Language Models: Less Is More
description: A 60-second lesson on Small Language Models: Less Is More.

hook.text: A 3-billion-parameter model runs on your phone and handles 80% of what you need. Is bigger always better?

buildup.text: Small language models (SLMs) are compressed, distilled, or purpose-built for efficiency.

discovery.text: Techniques like quantization and pruning shrink models while preserving most capability.

twist.text: For specific tasks — email drafting, code completion — small models match large ones.

climax.text: On-device AI means privacy, speed, and no internet needed. The future might be small.

punchline.text: The smartest model is the one that fits where you need it.

quiz.question: What advantage do small language models offer?
options: They run on-device for privacy and speed
They are always more accurate than large models

details.summary: Small language models with 1-7 billion parameters achieve impressive results through careful training on high-quality data. They run on personal devices, require less energy, and are practical for focused applications.
details.whyItMatters: Not every application needs GPT-4. Small models make AI accessible on phones, laptops, and embedded devices, enabling private, fast, and affordable AI without cloud dependency.
takeaways: Models with 1-7B parameters can perform well on focused tasks
High-quality training data matters more than raw model size
They enable private, offline AI on personal devices

faq.question: What can small language models do well?
faq.answer: They excel at focused tasks like summarization, classification, code completion, and question answering within specific domains. They struggle with broad knowledge and complex multi-step reasoning compared to larger models.

faq.question: What makes small models effective despite fewer parameters?
faq.answer: Training on curated, high-quality data rather than raw internet text. Techniques like distillation transfer knowledge from large models. Architecture efficiency improvements also help smaller models punch above their weight.
